tea-ceremony master in exile, pre-industrial, rendered as graphite concept art concept art moodboard, near-monochrome, frosted glass

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: high-contrast teal-and-orange with protected mid-tone skin. Lighting reference: golden-hour backlight with heavy lens flare control.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.
